lines.text: Gravity. The reason your phone always lands face first.
It's nothing personal. It's just physics.
Everything with mass pulls on everything else. Yes, even you pull on the Earth.
But Earth pulls back just as hard. It's just heavier, so you do all the moving.
Falling things speed up by almost ten meters per second, every second.
That's why tripping is embarrassing, but tripping off a cliff is a problem.
Isaac Newton got hit by an apple, and discovered gravity.
When I get hit by an apple, all I discover is pain.
On the Moon, gravity is six times weaker.
Finally, you could dunk. Honestly, it's the only place I'd be athletic.
Einstein showed that mass bends space, and everything just follows the curve.
So technically, you're not falling. You're just following directions.
So next time you trip, blame spacetime.
Follow for more science. Resistance is futile. Gravity always wins.
